family: Loop Powered Addressable Sounders, Beacons And SounderBeacons
summary: The Intelligent Addressable Open-Area Sounder of Context Plus has been designed for use in open areas, it is powered directly from the loop and need no external power supply.
description: The Context Plus Addressable panel will be able to drive up to twenty 55000-001 sounders per loop on average. However, the maximum number of devices that may be connected to a particular loop should be determined by a loop loading calculation.
Comes with a base which is fitted to the mounting surface and wired as a ‘first fix’.
features: Operates at 17–28V DC and is polarity sensitive.
Nominal sound output of 100dB(A) and is achieved at a current consumption of 5mA.
